econ-micro-01-c5.text: Steven A. Greenlaw, David Shapiro, Daniel MacDonald (2022). Principles of Economics 3e, 3.4 Price Ceilings and Price Floors. OpenStax.
econ-micro-01-c5.quote: Perhaps the best-known example of a price floor is the minimum wage.
econ-micro-01-c5.claim: Price ceilings (rent control) and price floors (minimum wage) lock prices off equilibrium and produce persistent shortages or surpluses.
